author: Konstantin Beznosov
title: Horrendous user experience
review_text: The combination of the app and the mobile payment service behind it, including customer support, was terrible. The app is not only unusable but also unreliable. The KYC process took more than a week. The customer support would just close help tickets without actually helping. Over the phone, the customer support was equally as bad, often just hanging up. Avoid e-Sewa by all means.

author: GC-Flow
title: Assistance for abroad people
review_text: I tried to contact the eSewa team via email looking for assistance regarding login. The issues have never been resolved. What a joke!

author: Izzy_zeed
title: Poor IT System
review_text: The IT system of eSewa is terrible. Why is a phone number required to verify everything? What about people living abroad who don’t have access to a local phone number? Why can’t you use email IDs for verification instead? This approach shows a lack of proper technological understanding. It’s frustrating and needs improvement.
